facts.fact: The National Identification Card carries an electronic chip that, once its digital functions are activated, can be used for secure electronic authentication and digital signature, per the Consular Portal.

CPV.note: No link with the civil register is stated.
Application is compulsory from age 4, but no count or share enrolled is given.
The card is optional at birth registration and the page does not say a number is given at birth.
The page says the State created the card; it does not say who operates or maintains the system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: The National Identification Card was created by the State through Decree-Law 19/2014 and is compulsory for all Cabo Verdean citizens from age 4, with applications taking 7 to 15 days, per the Consular Portal.
